summary: OS Therapies filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026 disclosing an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC for an at-the-market offering of up to $75 million of common stock under its effective Form S-3 shelf. Jefferies receives a 3.0% commission plus reimbursement of counsel fees up to $100,000. Shares may be sold through block transactions or on the principal market at company-designated minimum prices, with either party able to suspend sales. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure, dilution pace, and trading liquidity relative to the OSTX float.
